OFFICIAL SECRETS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
OFFICIAL SECRETS
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE LXVIII OF
2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the Official Secrets Act, 1923
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part-I, 7th October, 2002]
F.No.2(1)/2002-Pub. dated
7-10-2002.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President, is
hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Official Secrets
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once except in the Islamabad Capital Territory where it shall come into force
on such date as the Federal Government may, by notification in the Official
Gazette, specify.

Amendment of section 11, Act, XXX of 1923

An Ordinance

[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part-I, 7th October, 2002]
F.No.2(1)/2002-Pub. dated
7-10-2002.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President, is
hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 11,
Act, XXX of 1923.--In the Official Secrets Act 1923 (XIX of 1923)
hereinafter referred to as the said act in section 11,--
(a) in
subsection (1) the words "or Sub-Divisional Magistrate" shall be
omitted: and
(b) in
subsection (3), for the words "District or Sub-divisional" the words
"Magistrate of the first class having jurisdiction" shall be
substituted.

Amendment of section 13, Act, XXX of 1923
